e.title: Insurance Voice Bot (Qwen2.5)
e.summary: 保险销售语音机器人（Qwen2.5-1.5B 微调，206 下载，Apache-2.0）：低延迟保险销售语音回复——一次一个发现式问题
e.summary_en: Insurance sales voice bot (Qwen2.5-1.5B fine-tuned, 206 downloads, Apache-2.0): low-latency insurance sales voice replies — one discovery question at a time
e.summary_hk: 保險銷售語音機器人（Qwen2.5-1.5B 微調，206 下載，Apache-2.0）：低延遲保險銷售語音回覆——一次一個發現式問題
e.body: Insurance Real-Time Voice Bot（Muneebmn123，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 微调，206 下载，Apache-2.0）是保险销售语音回复的微调模型：低延迟的口语化短回答、每次一个发现式问题（discovery question）——保险销售语音 bot 的对话模型。对 RIAA：保险语音 AI——[[insurance-support-agent]]（客服 agent）的语音版本；Qwen2.5 微调（[[qwen-dianjin]] 中文金融生态相关）；销售对话（[[insurance-agent-trainer]] 培训场景）；低延迟设计（实时语音交互）；与 [[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]]（多模态语音）配套；适合保险语音交互与销售 AI。
e.body_en: The Insurance Real-Time Voice Bot (Muneebmn123, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, 206 downloads, Apache-2.0) is a fine-tuned model for insurance sales voice replies: low-latency short spoken answers, one discovery question at a time — the dialogue model of insurance sales voice bots. For RIAA: insurance voice AI — the voice version of [[insurance-support-agent]] (customer-service agents); Qwen2.5 fine-tuning (related to the [[qwen-dianjin]] Chinese financial ecosystem); sales dialogue (the [[insurance-agent-trainer]] training scenario); low-latency design (real-time voice interaction); pairs with [[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]] (multimodal voice); suits insurance voice interaction and sales AI.
e.body_hk: Insurance Real-Time Voice Bot（Muneebmn123，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 微調，206 下載，Apache-2.0）是保險銷售語音回覆的微調模型：低延遲的口語化短回答、每次一個發現式問題（discovery question）——保險銷售語音 bot 的對話模型。對 RIAA：保險語音 AI——[[insurance-support-agent]]（客服 agent）的語音版本；Qwen2.5 微調（[[qwen-dianjin]] 中文金融生態相關）；銷售對話（[[insurance-agent-trainer]] 培訓場景）；低延遲設計（實時語音交互）；與 [[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]]（多模態語音）配套；適合保險語音交互與銷售 AI。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：HF 模型（Qwen2.5 语音微调，206 下载），未实测
